stem: A biography on the military career of General Thomas "Stonewall" Jackson would include his involvement in which Civil War events?

options.label: A
options.text: The First Battle of Bull Run and the Confederate victory at Fredericksburg

options.label: B
options.text: The Union capture of Atlanta and the March to the Sea through Georgia

options.label: C
options.text: The Virginia Peninsula campaign and the Union victory at Gettysburg

options.label: D
options.text: The campaigns in northern Virginia and the Confederate surrender at Appomattox Court House
